state.objective: Diagnose why external API webhooks fail during TLS handshake.

context.content: HTTP client pool created with max_connections=50.

Packet capture analysis: Client sends TLS ClientHello; Server responds with fragmented Certificate (4096-bit RSA chain > MTU 1500); DF bit set causes PMTUD blackhole on router 10.0.1.1 drop ICMP Fragmentation Needed

submitted_answer.answer: TLS handshake fails because the oversized certificate chain requires fragmentation, but router 10.0.1.1 drops ICMP Fragmentation Needed messages, creating a PMTUD blackhole. Allow ICMP or enable TCP MTU probing.
